# yoshi389111/github-profile-3d-contrib

A 3D contribution calendar with a language pie and a contribution radar. Generated with `yoshi389111/github-profile-3d-contrib@latest`. The built-in night images come without settings; the others come from `.github/showcase/3d-contrib.json` on `main`, passed in `SETTING_JSON`.

## Built in

### Night view

`profile-night-view.svg`

![Night view](profile-night-view.svg)

### Night green

`profile-night-green.svg`

![Night green](profile-night-green.svg)

### Night rainbow

`profile-night-rainbow.svg`

![Night rainbow](profile-night-rainbow.svg)
